character.note: Two-learner contrast named directly in each worked-example (weaker Tom first, then stronger Amara), now as students in the School of Sport. Not token substituted.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for creativity-advanced. This frames creativity as a graduate attribute for the School of Sport as a whole, drawing worked examples from across its subjects (sport & exercise science in L01, sport coaching in L02, sport management and development in L03, with strength & conditioning and sport therapy and rehabilitation named in framing). There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark file.
